entries.value: Arthur Whetsel(t); Otto Hardwick(sax); Duke Ellington(p); Elmer Snowden(bj); possibly Sonny Greer(d).

entries.content: This "trial" recording was rejected, and doesn't survive in any form. Victor's file entry for this session omits names of players, recalled by Elmer Snowden's as the original Washingtonians: Whetsel, Hardwick, Ellington, Snowden and Greer (but Greer didn't confirm his presence). It is not known which saxophone Hardwick played, and Snowden occasionally doubled sax. More details in Steven Lasker's contribution on [DEMS Bulletin 96/2 p.7](http://tdwaw.ellingtonweb.ca/DEMS/DEMS1996-2.pdf)
